paragraphs: Atomic Jolt builds custom learning management system solutions for colleges and universities. Its LTI products are meant to make Canvas, Moodle, D2L and Blackboard more effective for institutions that want to deliver a better learning experience. The company also writes custom web, mobile and LMS software to fit an institution's instructional needs. It will set up, host, maintain and support Canvas for an institution as well.

Atomic Search, one of those apps, is an LTI 1.3 Advantage tool for finding pages, files, assignments, discussions, modules or content inside files. It respects user roles, so people see only content they are authorized to access. Teachers and administrators can view usage analytics on top of that. Another product inserts discussions directly into LMS content.

The company points to over 20 years of experience with IMS standards, learning management systems and online learning. Its curriculum staff develop and enhance curricula for K-12, higher education and adult education. RMIT University Vietnam used Atomic Polls and Atomic Discussions to turn a course into an interactive and reflective learning experience. The Virginia Department of Criminal Justice Services partnered with the Atomic Jolt curriculum services team on a suite of 11 short courses. Those courses had to be 508 compliant, or fully screen-reader accessible.
